intent.proves: At least one price matrix entry is scoped to a user, user group, customer number or group customer number.

bindings.reason: get_prices_by_product_id reads prices per product; no whole-host price enumeration tool exists, so a host-wide count is not an equivalent observation.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomPrices WHERE ISNULL(PriceUserId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceUserGroupId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceUserCustomerNumber, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(PriceCustomerGroupId, N'') <> N''
